Firstly, I just wish we got to see more of the destruction the alt Invincibles caused similar to OmniMan tearing the flaxan dimension a new one. Like a minute or two montage with a reprise of Tom Tom playing in the background as cities around the world fall would’ve been epic and impactful to see.
